Metadata.title: Kristal
Metadata.wikiDescription: Documentation for the powerful DELTARUNE fangame engine, Kristal.

Home.about: Kristal is a powerful DELTARUNE fangame and battle engine, made with LÖVE. It allows you to make custom DELTARUNE worlds, battles, and more!
Home.use: Check out our wiki for more information on how to use Kristal. Please keep in mind that you must know Lua, or be willing to learn it! We have our own Lua tutorial to help you get started.
Home.help: Yes! Feel free to look through the source code of Kristal and contribute if you wish.

0.description: WORLDS ENTER COLLISION. THE KNIGHT IS TO NO FAULT. Join the fun gang in a liminal exploration reminiscent to Yume Nikki & Mario 64 B3313 crossed over with Dark Worlds!

1.description: A take on Chapter 5's Weird Route. Explore a new Dark World, find unique weapons and armors to try and defeat the Awakened Frostmancer, Noelle.

2.description: The gaming console. The dusty screen. And HE, asking for one last challenge, like in the old days. Gaining the power from the wires, RAMB became stronger. Now, will you be able to defeat him?

3.description: Join the DELTA WARRIORS in a journey to break the endless cycle, and free everyone from their fate. In this fangame, you can play small snippets of Deltarune: UZUMAKI's hypothetical Chapters 3 to 7. The demo is currently in development, so please have patience!

4.description: Two roads lie ahead for Kris—and they can’t hear your voice anymore. All they know is this: they will not walk either path as a puppet, and you are the last thread left to cut.

5.description: Take your place amongst the Gods. 40+ boss fights, challenge modes, and a unique ending. Contains major spoilers for Hollow Knight.

6.description: Alexa Greene, a victim of something terrible, starts her adventure through the world of Europa. Will she make new friends and keep sane, or will she succumb to her insanity? The choice is yours.

7.description: The end of the Snowgrave Route seen from another place. While Kris gets torn to pieces by a bootleg Mettaton NEO, Susie has to face Noelle, lost in the trance of the Thorn Ring, before she freezes her to death! And who knows, maybe the situation can get even worse than that?

8.description: Explore the vast region that Kris calls home as you aid them in becoming champion! Your rivals Susie, Noelle and Berdly join alongside you to see and catch over 200+ Pokémon from Kanto to Paldea!

9.description: Traverse through different worlds and realities, and save the multiverse from being consumed by darkness and anomalies!

WikiHome.intro: Kristal is an *awesome* DELTARUNE fangame engine, written in Lua, using LÖVE.
WikiHome.gettingStartedText: No matter whether you're making a fangame, or playing one, the first step is downloading the engine. Read the download guide for more information!
WikiHome.contributingText: If you want to contribute wiki articles, you can do so by forking the website's GitHub repository and making a pull request. If you want to document the API, it is generated automatically from the annotations in Kristal's source code.
